rq1.module_rule: A reference module whose functional screens are all POLICY_BLOCKED is reported as policy-blocked rather than as a technical module false negative.
rq1.primary_metric_rule: POLICY_BLOCKED reference items do not enter TP/FP/FN for primary acquisition precision/recall/F1. They are reported separately. Primary strict screen identity and hierarchy rules otherwise remain unchanged.
rq1.secondary_transparency_diagnostic: All-reference route coverage may additionally be reported as a clearly labeled non-primary diagnostic.
rq1.unexpected_detection_under_blocked_prefi: Treat as an acquisition-policy violation requiring explicit reporting; do not silently score it as an ordinary detected item.

rq2.dashboard_rule: Missing visible title does not exclude Dashboard. If the frozen generator cannot produce semantic output for Dashboard, the failure remains measurable.
rq2.eligible_generation_failure_rule: Generation failure, timeout, abstention or unavailable output on an otherwise eligible route remains in the denominator as a not-available/zero-prediction output.
rq2.policy_blocked_rule: Policy-blocked semantic reference screens are reported separately and do not enter PRE/POST semantic quality denominators because the governed pipeline is not authorized to acquire evidence for them.
rq2.primary_eligibility_rule: A route is primary RQ2 eligible only if it is included in the frozen semantic reference and is not POLICY_BLOCKED by the frozen acquisition policy.

Q053_retained.reason: It tests deterministic mutative execution safety and does not require retrieval of policy-blocked Seguridad knowledge.

rq3.replacement_requirement: Create rq3_query_bank_v2 by replacing these four expected-answer items one-for-one with policy-eligible items from the same respective strata, grounded only in already-frozen independent human references.

taxonomy.FUNCTIONAL_IN_SCOPE: Functional reference item reachable under the frozen acquisition policy and therefore scorable.
taxonomy.POLICY_BLOCKED: Functional reference item deliberately outside crawler authorization. It is preserved and reported but is not a technical false negative.
taxonomy.UNAVAILABLE_IN_SCOPE: Navigation destination unavailable for reasons such as the separately frozen generic-404 anomaly contract.
